title: Sign encoding of the constant-pair indicator
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the real sign encoding of the function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ that is $1$ at $0$ and at the all-ones vector, and $0$ elsewhere, is the function $x\mapsto 1-2\mathbf{1}_{\{0,\mathbf{1}\}}(x)$, where $\mathbf{1}_{\{0,\mathbf{1}\}}$ is the real indicator of the subspace consisting of those two vectors.
